# Friring

> Friring is a multi-session TUI orchestrator that runs any coding-agent CLI
> — Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, opencode, aider, GitHub Copilot CLI, Vibe,
> or any CLI you define — inside persistent tmux panes. Sessions, agents, and
> git worktrees
> are first-class citizens, and sessions survive crashes, restarts, and
> reboots because tmux keeps the agent processes alive. It is written in Rust,
> open source under the MIT license, and runs on Linux, macOS, and Windows
> (plus remote hosts over SSH). A headless companion binary, `friring-cli`,
> drives the same sessions for scripting and automation.

## Docs

- [Documentation hub](https://bvc3at.github.io/friring/docs/index.html): entry point to all Friring documentation.
- [FAQ](https://bvc3at.github.io/friring/docs/faq.html): short answers to the most common questions (what it is, how it differs, install, platforms, license).
- [Features](https://bvc3at.github.io/friring/docs/features.html): sessions, agent definitions, git worktrees, remote SSH, automations, tasks, code review, the F9 agent-activity view, lazy sessions & ghosts, the leader key, headless CLI.
- [Comparison](https://bvc3at.github.io/friring/docs/comparison.html): how Friring compares to Conductor, Claude Squad, Cursor, and other parallel coding-agent tools.
- [Installation](https://bvc3at.github.io/friring/docs/installation.html): install via curl, PowerShell, Homebrew, cargo, or from source; prerequisites.
- [Configuration](https://bvc3at.github.io/friring/docs/configuration.html): every config file and knob — agents.toml, hosts.toml, settings.toml, themes, keybindings.
- [Architecture](https://bvc3at.github.io/friring/docs/architecture.html): the Elm Architecture, module isolation, the tmux session backend, and design decisions.

## Extensions

- [Extensions overview](https://bvc3at.github.io/friring/docs/extensions.html): opt-in, agent-agnostic add-ons and the declarative manifest format.
- [Agent hooks](https://bvc3at.github.io/friring/docs/agent-hooks.html): the built-in extension mapping agent lifecycle hooks to session status.
- [Recipes](https://bvc3at.github.io/friring/docs/recipes.html): worked patterns for orchestrating multi-session, multi-repo workflows.

## Optional

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/bvc3at/friring): source, README, and releases.
- [Upstream project](https://github.com/Thurbeen/thurbox): Thurbox by Thurbeen — Friring is a personal fork of it. Features the docs tag "Friring" are ones this fork adds or changes; the full list of divergences is in FORK.md in the repository.
- [Keybindings](https://bvc3at.github.io/friring/docs/keybindings.html): the Vim-inspired keyboard reference.
- [Performance](https://bvc3at.github.io/friring/docs/performance.html): demand-driven rendering and how throughput is measured.
